title: lauridia tetragona
intro: Lauridia tetragona, commonly known as the "forest marigold", is a plant species that belongs to the family Iridaceae. The health benefits of Lauridia tetragona include its potential to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems.
